title: agent_router.result ubus event (what router_display reads)
description: Published by the agent bridge once per transcript. On NSP boards router_display relays replies and keeps get_info for Details or prepared writes for explicit panel Confirm. Bridge-dispatched requests (input.confirm:true, prepared) are never kept for local execution. Voice replies use session-scoped dedupe and unique panel tokens; docs/json_command_protocol.md describes the CDC1 mapping. No execution result is published back to the agent.

source.description: Producer source, fallback when input.source is absent.

session_id.description: Fallback producer lifetime identity when input.session_id is absent.

boot_id.description: Optional boot identity; a kernel boot ID does not change when STT restarts.

seq.description: Fallback producer sequence when input.seq is absent.

input.description: Preserve the transcript metadata verbatim. The transcript text is not displayed.

confirm.description: true with prepared means the bridge owns dispatch; no command is retained for a panel tap.

request_id.description: Producer correlation ID (usually STT seq). Locally kept commands are rewritten to a unique router-issued panel token; llm_reply.producer_rid retains this original ID. Direct bridge-dispatched requests keep the original rid. 0 = adapter error with no known request.

status.description: ok | prepared | clarify | not_found | data_unavailable | unsupported | unknown | error. Any non-empty string is relayed; the panel shows the message only for ok, prepared, not_found and data_unavailable.

message.description: User-facing text, or null. Absent is read as null (a blob producer may omit a null). Cut at 1000 bytes on a UTF-8 boundary before it reaches the panel.

command.description: The firmware command (firmware-command-v1.schema.json) or null. Absent is read as null. Only command, target and arguments are copied, for the panel's Details card.
